messages.author: e6fe67afbf00f1cd
messages.subject: Bootstrapping with Poststratification by Species
parts:
Dear List

I conducted multi-species bird point surveys on 20 different sites (no. of
points from 10-15) with the aim of obtaining density estimates for each
species at each site. Even with detections pooled across sites there were
not sufficient detections for all species, so I have grouped species of
similar detectability into small groups (2-3 species). To obtain density
estimates I have tried two methods.

1) Using the CDS engine, I used a filter to select a group, with the
detection function fitted at a global level and density estimates at the
sample(point) level. Post stratification to species (entered at the
observation level) was used. This gave me density estimates for each
species per point.

2) Using the MCDS engine, again using a filter to select a group and using
species as a covariate. Again the detection function was fitted at a
global level and density estimates at the sample(point) level. Post
stratification to species (entered at the observation level) was used. This
gave me density estimates for each species per point.

I would like to carry out model averaging/variance estimates via
bootstrapping within each of the two methods, but the problem is that the
bootstrap won't work when density is estimated by sample. Can I solve this
by using multipliers?

I would also like to carry out model averaging with both the CDS and MCDS
models if possible, does anyone have advice on how to carry out an external
bootstrap routine? My knowledge of R is pretty limited...

Many thanks
----------------------
Catherine Davey
School of Biological Sciences
University of Bristol
Woodland Road
Bristol BS8 1UG

Catheri...@bris.ac.uk
